channel.title: Oil, gas & power · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.1).

item.title: [−1] US forces fire on and disable a ship trying to breach the Iran blockade; Iran blacklists more ships
item.description:
Iranian media say 11 tankers caught fire over nine days; another tanker hit a mine. Qatar says both sides remain committed to talks. Ongoing standoff.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Supply risk

Why it matters: Continued blockade clashes keep shipping risk high in the Gulf, sustaining freight and insurance costs for India-bound cargo.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [−1] Houthis claim six missile and drone attacks on Saudi oil sites and Riyadh airport
item.description:
Targets reportedly included oil tanks, a distillation tower and a pumping station; Saudi Arabia has not confirmed damage. Saudi strikes killed dozens in Yemen. Escalating.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Supply risk

Why it matters: Attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure threaten a key Indian crude supplier and could revive the oil risk premium after last week's slide.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Hormuz could reopen under a Qatari plan tied to Iranian nuclear inspections
item.description:
The framework would trade an end to attacks for lifting the US port blockade. Iran called the US reply 'unconvincing'. Diplomacy ongoing.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Supply relief

Why it matters: A reopening would ease oil, LNG and freight costs for India; uncertainty keeps confidence low.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Hormuz disruption risks a global LNG crunch this winter, threatening India's power and gas costs
item.description:
Analysts warn constrained Gulf flows could tighten LNG supply as winter demand rises. Follows a 6% jump in global LNG prices last week. Ongoing risk.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Gas costs

Why it matters: Tighter LNG would raise costs for gas-based power, fertiliser and city gas, adding to subsidies and electricity tariffs.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
